title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule E: Labor Rate Card
content:
Billable labor under ClearPath Managed IT Services is priced from this rate card: the hourly rates for remote and onsite work during coverage hours, the after-hours multiplier, the onsite hours included each month, the onsite trip charge, and the minute increments and minimums.

## E.1 Rates and allowances

| Tier | Remote hourly rate (USD) | Onsite hourly rate (USD) | After-hours multiplier | Included onsite hours per month | Onsite trip charge per billable visit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 165.00 | 185.00 | 2.0 | 0 | 95.00 |
| ClearPath Essentials | 155.00 | 175.00 | 1.5 | 0 | 95.00 |
| ClearPath Standard | 150.00 | 170.00 | 1.5 | 2 | 85.00 |
| ClearPath Professional | 145.00 | 160.00 | 1.5 | 4 | 0.00 |
| ClearPath Premier | 140.00 | 155.00 | 1.5 | 8 | 0.00 |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 135.00 | 150.00 | 1.5 | 16 | 0.00 |

- The remote and onsite hourly rates apply to billable labor during coverage hours; the after-hours multiplier is applied to the hourly rate for billable labor outside coverage hours.
- Included onsite hours are the onsite labor hours per calendar month included in the seat fee before onsite labor becomes billable; unused hours do not carry over.
- The trip charge is a flat charge per billable onsite visit.

## E.2 Minute increments and minimums

| Tier | Billing increment | Minimum per billable remote ticket | Minimum per billable onsite visit |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 30 minutes | 30 minutes | 120 minutes |
| ClearPath Essentials | 15 minutes | 15 minutes | 60 minutes |
| ClearPath Standard | 15 minutes | 15 minutes | 60 minutes |
| ClearPath Professional | 15 minutes | 15 minutes | 60 minutes |
| ClearPath Premier | 15 minutes | 15 minutes | 60 minutes |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 15 minutes | 15 minutes | 60 minutes |

Billable labor minutes are rounded up to the billing increment.

## E.3 Hypothetical illustration

On ClearPath Essentials, 50 recorded remote minutes round up to 60 billable minutes; on ClearPath Monitor, 50 minutes round up to 60 as well, while 70 minutes round up to 90. A 40-minute onsite visit on ClearPath Essentials is billed at its 60-minute minimum.
